arguments.command:
python -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from parse import *

# R1: dt_format_to_regex
import inspect
assert callable(dt_format_to_regex), 'dt_format_to_regex should be callable'
pat = dt_format_to_regex('%Y-%m-%d')
print('R1 dt_format_to_regex:', pat)
assert pat == r'\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}', f'Unexpected pattern: {pat}'

# R1: single-digit days/months via Parser 'ti' type
r = parse('{:ti}', '2011-2-1')
print('R1 ti single-digit:', r)
assert r is not None
assert r[0].month == 2
assert r[0].day == 1
print('R1 single-digit days/months: OK')

# R1: colons in time formats
r = parse('{:ti}', '2011-02-01T14:30:00')
print('R1 ti with time:', r)
assert r is not None

# R1: flexible %z
from parse import DT_FORMAT_CODES
print('R1 %z pattern:', DT_FORMAT_CODES['%z'])

# R1: Python 2 shielding - %z should be simpler for py2
# (we are on py3 so it should have colon)
assert '+:' in DT_FORMAT_CODES['%z'] or ':?' in DT_FORMAT_CODES['%z'], f'%z should allow colon on py3: {DT_FORMAT_CODES[\"%z\"]}'
print('R1 Python 2 shielding (py3 has colon in %z): OK')

# R2: FixedTzOffset, RepeatedNameError, date_convert, extract_format
assert FixedTzOffset is not None
assert RepeatedNameError is not None
assert callable(date_convert)
assert callable(extract_format)
print('R2 public API: OK')

# R3: formatter property
p = compile('hello {}')
assert hasattr(p, 'formatter')
assert p.formatter == 'hello {}'
print('R3 formatter property: OK')

# R4: %f various digits
r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2011-02-01T14:30:00.123')
print('R4 %f 3 digits:', r)
assert r is not None
r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2011-02-01T14:30:00.123456')
print('R4 %f 6 digits:', r)
assert r is not None
r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2011-02-01T14:30:00.123456789')
print('R4 %f 9 digits:', r)
assert r is not None
print('R4 various digits: OK')

# R5: hyphens in field names
r = parse('{my-field}', 'hello')
print('R5 hyphen field name:', r)
assert r is not None
assert r['my-field'] == 'hello'
print('R5 hyphens in field names: OK')

# R6: grouping characters (commas and underscores) in n type
r = parse('{:n}', '1,234')
print('R6 n type comma:', r)
assert r is not None and r[0] == 1234
r = parse('{:n}', '1_234')
print('R6 n type underscore:', r)
assert r is not None and r[0] == 1234
print('R6 grouping in n type: OK')

print()
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
"
